A claim of knowing p is not proof of p. A says p does not establish A privately believes p. Nested attribution cannot be detached into the inner person actual state. Outer denial is not inner denial. Sincerity assumptions are not established facts. Preserve source-local identity, unknowns and challenges; unsupported rows are history, not current support.
